name: selfEmployeeTrainingApplication
description: Lets an Employee apply for a specific scheduled training for themselves. Resolves the schedule from either scheduleId or courseName, then probes eligibility via ValidateApplyTraining (safe - it does not write anything) before requiring any narrative fields, surfacing leave-date clashes for the selected schedule along the way. Only once eligibility is confirmed does it report which of objective/relevanceToJob/benefitToEmployee/benefitToCompany are still needed; once all are supplied it runs the same validate-then-save flow (ValidateApplyTraining -> SaveApplyTraining) with AppType 000001 and an empty NomiList (self-application does not select an employee in an outgoing list - the applicant is resolved from session identity). This is a write tool - it submits a real training application on success.
